text:
Rowbase: turn your spreadsheets into APIs

Rowbase launched on March 4, 2026. It turns CSV files into live APIs you can query, and you don't have to set anything up first.

Upload a file and Rowbase generates a documented API endpoint within seconds, ready for your apps to call. It supports five file formats, so you can probably use the data you already have as is.

The free tier includes 1,000 requests per day. That's enough to build, test, and ship something before you pay anything.

212 beta users tried Rowbase before launch, and their feedback changed almost every feature. Thank you to everyone who signed up early.

To try it, go to rowbase.dev and upload your first CSV. We'd love to see what you build with it.
